result.topic_en: Scattered sketches and calculations on Gaussian integers (complex numbers a+bi): multiplication by i, residues modulo 1+i and 2, lattice grids with numbered squares showing residue classes, and quotients such as (1+6i)/(1+2i), connected with biquadratic residues.
